semantics.provider: offline fixed scores; reported usage is a synthetic reference-token count; no billed requests
semantics.quality: not measured; use bench:retrieval for real provider judgments
semantics.cache: new score cache and fresh process per sample; four ordered searches share one engine; no preparation cache exists
semantics.cold: cold process/tokenizer/score cache; OS filesystem cache is uncontrolled; startup/imports and fixture setup excluded
semantics.timings: inclusive stages overlap; provider includes adapter work and waiting, not isolated network time
semantics.memory: sampled maxima at instrumented boundaries; process peak RSS covers the whole child including setup
